schedules.description: Daily review of items needing attention across Slack and Confluence
schedules.prompt:
Review my pending items and things that need attention. Check the following sources only:

1. **Gmail** — Search for:
   - Unread emails or threads needing a reply (last 3 days)
   - Emails flagged/starred or marked important
   - Anything with urgency, deadlines, action items, or follow-up requests directed at me

2. **Slack** — Search for:
   - Direct messages sent to me that may need a reply (last 3 days)
   - Messages mentioning urgency, deadlines, follow-ups, or action items addressed to me
   - Any unanswered questions or requests in DMs and group DMs
   - Messages I sent where I asked a question or made a request but have NOT received a reply yet — i.e. threads or DMs where I am waiting on someone's response

3. **Confluence** — Search for:
   - Pages recently assigned to me or where I'm mentioned
   - Pages pending my review or approval
   - Any action items or comments directed at me

4. **Jenkins** — Check for failed/aborted builds but ONLY for jobs whose name contains 'kwikchat' or 'kc' (KwikChat team jobs). Ignore all other Jenkins jobs.

5. **GitHub** — Check for open PRs and issues but ONLY in repositories that are mirrored from Bitbucket under the KC (KwikChat) namespace — these are repos prefixed with 'kc-' (e.g. kc-send-message, kc-*, etc.). Ignore all other repositories.

Do NOT check ArgoCD.

Once all sources are checked, compile and send a Slack DM to U06MHDGLGLC (prashant.sharma@gokwik.co) using this exact format:

*Daily Attention Review — {date}*

*GMAIL*
- <url|Sender Name (date/time)> — brief summary — urgency

*SLACK*
Needs your reply:
- <slack_thread_url|Person Name (date/time)> — brief summary

Waiting on someone:
- <slack_thread_url|Person Name> — what you asked, waiting since when

*CONFLUENCE*
- <confluence_url|Page Title> — why it needs attention

*JENKINS*
- <jenkins_url|Job Name> — failure reason

*GITHUB*
- <github_url|Repo/PR Title> — what needs attention

Rules:
- Every item MUST have a clickable link using Slack format <url|text>
- Skip any source section entirely if there is nothing to report
- Sort items within each section by urgency (most urgent first)
- Keep each item to one line
schedules.notes: Sources: Gmail, Slack, Confluence, Jenkins (kc/* jobs only), GitHub (kc-* repos only). ArgoCD excluded.
